en: A black‑and‑white framed postcard view of a large institutional complex set on sloping terrain with hills in the background. The long, rectangular main building has many evenly spaced windows and several wings, resembling a school or orphanage complex. In the foreground are fields, a dirt road, a few people walking, and utility poles. Printed text at the bottom identifies the place as the American Orphanage in Syra.
